text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. You don't need to go to the gym every day; a simple walk or bike ride can help. Third, get enough sleep, about seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget your mental health. Talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. These simple habits can make you feel happier and healthier.
